name: James Macpherson
credit: No confirmed portrait sourced for this archive.
bio: James Macpherson was a Scottish writer born at Ruthven in Inverness-shire, who published the prose-poems attributed to Ossian between 1760 and 1763. They had a European influence and a long controversy over their authenticity.
Gilfillan prints several Ossianic passages in prose, which are not taken here, and one poem in rhyme, The Cave, which is.
